ViridianCity_School_EventScript_ReadFree: A frozen POKéMON becomes  helplessly immobile.  It stays frozen even after the  battle ends.  Use ICE HEAL to thaw out the  suffering POKéMON.
ViridianCity_School_EventScript_ReadPara: Paralysis reduces SPEED and may  prevent the POKéMON from moving.  Paralysis remains after battles.  Use PARLYZ HEAL for treatment.
